profile.name: Matias Suxo
profile.summary: I build AI tools, web applications, and the occasional circuit board. Currently developing AI platforms at the University of Ottawa.
profile.education: Honours BSc Computer Science, Management and Entrepreneurship Option, French Immersion Stream

experiences.summary: Developing AI platforms and agentic applications for university use.
details: Part-time from Sep 2025 to Jan 2026; full-time contract from Jan 2026 to present.
Works across multi-agent orchestration, retrieval, privacy-aware workflows and platform integration.
Public project work includes uOttawa Chat, Altura and the uOGenAI initiative.

experiences.summary: Full-stack software development and IT operations across institutional systems.
details: Full-stack development across Laravel, Next.js, NestJS and Docker.
Supported on-premises IT operations alongside software development.

experiences.summary: Electrical and embedded development for an underwater robotics club.

experiences.summary: Elected Engineering representative contributing to student governance.

projects.title: Elvyn
projects.summary: Bilingual patient simulation platform for nursing education and research.
details: An RMGN education and research prototype for practising nursing interviews in English and French.
Learners prepare for assigned scenarios, speak with simulated patients and submit structured feedback.
The project is not clinical software, a diagnostic tool or a patient record.

projects.title: Altura / uOttawa Chat
projects.summary: A supervised multi-agent assistant for uOttawa services, study support and campus questions.
details: An active-development chat interface with a supervised parent and five specialist agents.
Uses Microsoft Agent Framework and Azure OpenAI for the parent, Study Coach and Software Finder, with Copilot Studio specialists.
Users approve specialist handoffs, while public-data tools remain read-only.

projects.title: Knowledge Retrieval Service
projects.summary: Search service for private knowledge bases with separate query and indexing processes.
details: A NestJS API and indexing worker for private knowledge bases in Qdrant.
NestJS API and worker share a pipeline for parsing, chunking, embeddings and refreshes.
Supports text and vector queries with collection-scoped read access. Refreshes publish complete generations only after validation.

projects.title: uOGenAI
projects.summary: University of Ottawa generative-AI platform work presented at an applied medical AI summit.
details: A University of Ottawa generative-AI platform with student-facing tools, agent interfaces and controlled knowledge resources.
The initiative spans RAG, privacy-aware retrieval, governance and platform integration.
A public presentation connected the work to the Ottawa Applied Medical AI Summit.

projects.title: Print Hub
projects.summary: Docker dashboard for managing multiple 3D-printing services from one entry point.
details: Centralizes OctoPrint, Klipper and Bambu printer services behind one dashboard.
Uses Docker Compose, service discovery and a single entry point for local printer infrastructure.

projects.title: AI RACER
projects.summary: Real-time platform for adversarial AI evaluation, RAG experiments and competitive play.
details: Combines stateful LLM conversations, retrieval and reranking with live races and spectating.
Uses Cloudflare Workers, D1, Vectorize, Workers AI, Durable Objects and WebSockets.
Includes JWT authentication, global chat and a leaderboard.
